correctness.rationale: The inverse Gram matrix is exactly rederived and verified; both piecewise kernels are algebraic identities. The endpoint integral follows from the two positive-leading-coefficient quadratic sign intervals, with their four roots inside the relevant cells. A 10-cell quadratic Bernstein control decomposition reduces all x to 29 rational upper certificates below 9/4, strictly less than the endpoint value. Exact rational checker executed and succeeded. The discontinuous sign character is an equality-condition argument, not a numerical inference.

value.rationale: The canonical first two-element C0 quadratic finite-element space has a natural precise stability norm. The result exactly computes this invariant, establishes where the Lebesgue-function peak resides and why the bounded-measurable versus continuous norm-attainment properties differ. These are stronger and more informative than a nonsharp boundedness estimate, and a reproducible benchmark for quadratic spline least-squares projection. The fixed equal partition is the unique symmetric one-knot mesh, not a contrived parameter slice.
